Name: Black And White Mod
Author: justin2131
Description:
Bored with the regular old portraits? The [size=4]Black And White Mod [/size][size=2]turns all of the portraits into a black and white photo, just like in a black and white movie.[/size]


[size=2]Requires [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][size=2] and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

[u][size=3]To Install[/size]
[/u]
Extract the zip file into StardewValley/Mods/
Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿ installed so the patches work.

Manifest.Name: BlackAndWhite
Manifest.Description: Turns all portraits into black and white.
